nodes.statement: Assume the setting of Theorem 3.7. Then for every $\varepsilon>0$, $N\in\mathbb{N}$ and every corresponding FNO $\mathcal{G}_\theta$ from Theorem 3.7 there exists a DeepONet $\mathcal{G}_\theta^*:\mathcal{X}\to L^2(D)$ with $\mathrm{width}({\bm{\beta}}) = \mathcal{O}(N^d)$, $\mathrm{depth}({\bm{\beta}}) =\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{depth}(\mathcal{G}_\theta))$, $\mathrm{width}({\bm{\tau}}) =\mathcal{O}( N^{d+1})$ and $\mathrm{depth}({\bm{\tau}}) \leq 3$ that satisfies (3.6).
